bluesky.text:
A new app helps EU funding applicants write better proposals.
The same app scores those proposals for the evaluators.

When the coach and the judge are the same system — what exactly is being measured?

https://substack.com/profile/17146826-jose-antonio-morales/note/c-265851491

Today I saved half the time I usually spend preparing for a client workshop.

All my articles, drafts, and presentations in one place, retrieved with Claude's assistance. I just don't have such a memory.

https://automato.substack.com/p/ai-assisted-knowledge-management-4u

What should AI do and what should Humans do?

There is a line that AI can't cross: Human skill and mastery. It includes more than knowledge and speed; it comes with a deep understanding of Human emotions and behaviors, and a different sense of context.

Software distribution is no longer what most of us assume.

We won't buy software much longer. We'll buy instructions — specifications for AI to build exactly what we need, when we need it.

https://substack.com/@joseantoniomorales/note/c-240893735

The idea of a second brain sounds cool and a bit science fiction... but I won't let naive enthusiasm make me follow the narrative just like that.

My first question is: how can this be useful to me?
The discarded question: what can I do with these tools?
